infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BPR uses the camera so you can photograph a document or record a short video of an exercise for your therapist to review.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BPR needs access to your photos so you can attach a document or report to your record, or send your therapist a video of an exercise you did at home.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BPR saves a copy of documents you download from your clinical record.

plugins.faceIDPermission: BPR asks for Face ID so only you can open your clinical record on this device. Your password still works if Face ID is unavailable.

plugins.photosPermission: BPR needs access to your photos so you can attach a document or report to your record, or send your therapist a video of an exercise you did at home.
plugins.cameraPermission: BPR uses the camera so you can photograph a document or record a short video of an exercise for your therapist to review.
plugins.microphonePermission: BPR uses the microphone only while you record a video of your exercise, so your therapist hears what you say about it. Nothing is recorded otherwise.
